headline: BLAND (PROP) surges 18.33% on heavy volume and AGM resolution filing
market_take: Property stocks led the market with several double‑digit gains, highlighted by BLAND's 18.33% jump on volume 11.08× and an AGM resolution filing. Food showed strong upside in MADAME (+10.34%) and AQUA (+10.00%) amid volume spikes and a connected‑transaction filing for AQUA. Consumer and construction sectors were mixed, with TRITN down 33.33% and GEL down 25.00% on thin trading, while STPI posted a 7.69% rise on solid volume. Unusual‑trading alerts were widespread, especially high‑sigma volume spikes in AGRI and price‑gap moves in WIN and LUXF.
